research.question: What do visitors look for before they sign up?

scope.label: Our scope: landing page → sign-up → first use

steps.title: Sees an ad and gets curious
positives: Ad creative stands out in the feed
pains: Unclear what the product actually does

mindset.quote: Looks nice, but what is it?

steps.title: Lands on the product page
pains: No price shown above the fold

internal.quote: We've never tested showing price earlier

mindset.quote: I need to see the price before anything else.

hmw: show the price and delivery cost up front?

steps.title: Compares plans
positives: Plans are easy to compare side by side
pains: Too many add-ons to choose from

mindset.quote: I'll come back when I've had a think.

steps.title: Fills in the sign-up form
pains: Address lookup fails on new-build homes

steps.title: Gets the welcome email
pains: P1|Email didn't say what happens next

steps.title: Uses the product for the first time
positives: Customers who get started rate it highly
hmw: get new customers to first value in one sitting?

exits.label: Exit: leaves to think about it
